title: Santorini Caldera Escape
shortDescription: Cliffside suites, sunset sails, and volcanic wine tastings.
description: Six unhurried days along the Santorini caldera: private-terrace stays carved into the cliffs, a catamaran sunset sail past the volcano, and a walking tour of the island's oldest wineries. Built for couples who want the postcard view without the crowds.

tourPlan.title: Arrival in Fira
tourPlan.detail: Transfer to your cliffside suite, welcome dinner overlooking the caldera.

tourPlan.title: Oia & the Blue Domes
tourPlan.detail: Guided walk through Oia's whitewashed lanes, free afternoon.

tourPlan.title: Wine Country
tourPlan.detail: Vineyard tour and tasting across three historic wineries.

tourPlan.title: Sunset Sail
tourPlan.detail: Catamaran cruise past the volcano and hot springs, swim stop included.

tourPlan.title: Free Day
tourPlan.detail: Optional spa, beach clubs at Perissa, or explore Fira on your own.

tourPlan.title: Departure
tourPlan.detail: Morning at leisure, transfer to the airport.
